jobs.summary: One AutoScout cloud worker per brand — full scrape until exhausted
jobs.notes: Each worker owns one make via DAQ_AS24_MAKES and writes autoscout_<slug>.csv. No time cap by default. Prefer this over a single timed overnight process when you want all brands covered.
Default has no time cap (DAQ_COLLECT_DURATION_SECONDS=0). Pass --duration only when you intentionally want a timed stop.

jobs.summary: Parallel AutoScout workers — splits brands across N agents
jobs.notes: Disjoint DAQ_AS24_MAKES shards; runs until exhausted unless --duration set.
Resets exhausted facets; keeps known Ad IDs from coches_data.csv.
Single-worker full scrape (year×price facets). For parallel year-band ownership use coches_shard.

jobs.summary: Parallel coches.net workers — splits year bands across N agents
jobs.notes: Disjoint DAQ_COCHES_YEARS shards (catalog keys like 2024, 2005-2009, to-1989). Pass --makes with those keys to filter. Runs until exhausted unless --duration set.

jobs.notes: Single-worker full scrape. Default duration 0 (until facets exhausted). For parallel brand ownership use willhaben_shard / willhaben_by_brand.

jobs.summary: One Willhaben cloud worker per brand — full scrape until exhausted
jobs.notes: Each worker owns one brand via DAQ_WH_MAKES (brand SERP + brand×price facets) and writes willhaben_<slug>.csv. Cross-cutting price/year/region facets are excluded from sharded runs.
